name: Kafka Studio
description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.
releaseNotes: 2026-09-26 安全审查修复批次：解压全分支 16MiB 上限（LimitReader 与 zstd max-memory）并给 valueText 补齐同规格 base64 截断，杜绝解压炸弹；修复消费池竞态（consumePoolPut 跳过 inUse 条目，并发同形状消费不再互杀）；LoadSettings 补 cursorTtlSecs/maxCursorSessions 持久化往返；regex 过滤命中预编译缓存；stream/start 预校验 decode/decompression 参数。Schema Registry 客户端接入连接 TLS 配置，skip-verify 连接在审计中留痕并修订三值契约注释；消费组删除新增输入组名确认（ensureGroupDeleteConfirm，前端七语），CSS 令牌语义化。打包链路改为源码现构建前端（ui/index.html 脱库），build.sh 支持 DBX_PREBUILT_UI=1 复用 CI 预置产物。Security review fixes: 16MiB cap on all decompress branches (LimitReader + zstd max-memory) with matching base64 truncation for valueText to defuse decompression bombs; consume-pool race fix (consumePoolPut skips inUse entries so concurrent same-shape consumes no longer evict each other); LoadSettings now round-trips cursorTtlSecs/maxCursorSessions; regex filter hits the precompiled cache; stream/start pre-validates decode/decompression params. The Schema Registry client now honors connection TLS settings, skip-verify connections are recorded in the audit trail, and group deletion gained a type-the-group-name confirmation (seven languages). Packaging now builds the frontend from source (ui/index.html de-vendored), and build.sh supports DBX_PREBUILT_UI=1 to reuse CI-built UI.
